Class ModelBeanSearchTag

java.lang.Object
javax.servlet.jsp.tagext.TagSupport
ecmwf.ecpds.master.plugin.http.view.general.ModelBeanSearchTag
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, javax.servlet.jsp.tagext.IterationTag, javax.servlet.jsp.tagext.JspTag, javax.servlet.jsp.tagext.Tag
Direct Known Subclasses:
CommentsTag, NewsBeanSearchTag, ReferenceBeanSearchTag
public class ModelBeanSearchTag extends javax.servlet.jsp.tagext.TagSupport
Base JSP Tag which creates and executes a ModelBeanSearch, showing the results using some supplied parameters. It can be used directly or subclassed to get a more specific behaviour (see Hook Methods)
Version:
0.1.0
Author:
Daniel Varela Santoalla
